RemediationStrings.Title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus is not running
RemediationStrings.Description: The Microsoft Defender Antivirus service (WinDefend) is not running, so your device is not protected. Restart your device; if this message remains, contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus is not set to start automatically
RemediationStrings.Description: The Microsoft Defender Antivirus service has been changed so it will not start with Windows. Please contact the helpdesk.
